accepted_p0_foundation.interpretation: Exact accepted E0 contract foundation only; no later-stage permission is inherited.

current_core_theory.interpretation: Read-only authority. This route may create a challenger but may not alter, replace or promote the current core.

authority_binding.binding_effect: Authorization applies only while the exact cwd, branch, HEAD, accepted P0 decision and current core-theory identities above remain the declared baselines. Drift does not inherit authority and must stop for a new Sol decision.

authorized_objective.program_question: Can a versioned, state-conditioned runtime graph preserve distinct PathHypothesis, MechanismHypothesis and TradeHypothesis instances while updating only with discriminating point-in-time evidence and remaining non-self-authorizing?
authorized_objective.deliverable_goal: Produce a review-ready E0 challenger and executable contract package for deterministic runtime hypothesis generation, graph updates, machine predicates, identifiability, conflict, residual semantics, ordinal-to-calibrated boundaries and future out-of-sample acceptance design.
authorized_objective.maximum_current_result: A locally validated, exact E0 contract candidate awaiting a separate external Sol P0.1 completion gate.
not_a_goal: Prove that any mechanism is a market fact or participant-intent truth.
Prove market validity, predictive value, positive expected value, profitability or execution readiness.
Acquire data, implement an adapter, build a dataset, run a backtest, calibrate probabilities, open a holdout, paper trade, deploy or trade.
Modify or promote CORE_TRADING_THEORY.v2.1 or any frozen v1/v1.1 artifact.

authorized_artifact_allowlist.content_scope: Auditable theory delta, definitions, mathematical invariants, claim boundaries and future evaluation design only.
Three-layer specifications and instances, typed graph edges, deterministic generator and revision receipts, path non-merge, direction coverage and residual semantics.
Finite state-conditioned mechanism, path and trade templates with executable activation, signatures, terminal matchers, hard invalidation, expiry and exact template identities.
Atomic target-effect evidence, lineage and dependency handling, conflicts, identifiability, discrimination plans, probability modes and future out-of-sample gate fields.
Pure total public validator over caller-supplied raw candidate mappings with authority roots and semantic ceilings pinned outside candidate content.
Deterministic positive, malformed, mutation, authority, graph, non-merge, evidence, conflict, predicate, residual and probability-boundary fixtures only.
Exact commands, identities, test results, independent helper-free mutations, unresolved findings and bounded claim statement.
Exact route authority, immutable baselines, artifact paths, roles, byte lengths, physical digests, canonical digests where applicable and candidate claim boundary.

research_and_runtime_plane_separation: Static ResearchHypothesis objects test whether a method adds out-of-sample value.
Runtime MechanismHypothesis, PathHypothesis and TradeHypothesis instances are opportunity-specific decision objects in separate namespaces.
A runtime result cannot rewrite the static research hypothesis or a prior graph revision.
deterministic_generation: Runtime generation is a pure function of a point-in-time state, structural-position, data-quality and clock snapshot plus a frozen finite template registry.
Runtime or LLM free-form template creation, Cartesian-product path creation and outcome-conditioned generation are forbidden.
Only preregistered refresh triggers may create a new graph revision; all prior revisions and receipts remain immutable.
path_contract: Path identity is determined by its observable partial-order evolution, terminal matcher, horizon, invalidation and expiry, not by mechanism identity or trade side.
Different verifiable paths remain distinct even when they map to the same strategy side; their score, invalidation, expiry, calibration and result history cannot be merged.
Exact duplicate specifications are rejected before instantiation and do not become two runtime paths.
Named terminal path cells are pairwise disjoint; observable unmatched outcomes route to OTHER_PATH.
mechanism_contract: Mechanism hypotheses are non-exclusive observational explanations and can map many-to-many to paths.
Mechanism-to-path edges have NO_SCORE_TRANSFER at E0.
Without authoritative truth or an identification design, a mechanism can be observationally compatible or non-identifiable but cannot be promoted to fact, participant intent or causal truth.
trade_contract: Each TradeHypothesis has exactly one parent PathHypothesis instance in the minimal v1.2 contract.
Mechanism references are context-only and cannot authorize, size or strengthen a trade.
A path may generate zero or more path-specific trade hypotheses; a multi-path composite trade is outside this route.
Only a separately governed Permission object could authorize a future action, and every such permission remains unavailable in P0.1.
direction_and_residual_contract: The active pool preserves every eligible market path direction and every eligible trade side while allowing more than one distinct path for the same side.
A finite-capacity conflict returns POOL_OVERFLOW, UNKNOWN and ABSTAIN rather than silently pruning an opposing direction.
OTHER_PATH is an observable market-outcome residual.
UNKNOWN_PATH is an explicit epistemic meta-node with not_outcome, not_probability and not_tradeable semantics.
CENSORED is an outcome-labeling state and ABSTAIN is an action; neither is a market path.
evidence_and_conflict_contract: Each evidence item binds source or measurement identity, available_at, quality, lineage root, dependency group, expiry and an atomic per-target effect vector.
Only evidence with different preregistered implications across unresolved competitors is discriminating evidence.
One underlying lineage may contribute at most once per target and update; copied aliases cannot create independent evidence.
Equal-strength opposing evidence produces an explicit conflict or unknown state rather than selecting a semantic winner by identifier.
Hard invalidation dominates ordinal score; invalidated or expired instances cannot be revived.
identifiability_and_next_observation_con: Each pair of named paths must be terminal-identifiable; any pair used to prefer a trade before its deadline must also be decision-identifiable.
Observationally equivalent mechanisms remain in a declared equivalence class and cannot be forced into a unique causal choice.
Before probability calibration, the next-observation plan is a deterministic discrimination ranking, not Shannon information gain.
Numeric information gain is forbidden unless both path probabilities and conditional observation distributions are independently calibrated within the supported domain.
probability_and_oos_contract: Ordinal support cannot be converted to probability by softmax, normalization or candidate assertion.
Only named observable path outcomes plus OTHER_PATH may enter a future calibrated probability simplex; UNKNOWN_PATH cannot.
Trade-success probability is separately conditional on an exact trigger and parent path; mechanism probability remains forbidden without a truth label.
All future sample, coverage, effect, non-inferiority, calibration, multiplicity and stability thresholds remain UNSET_BLOCKS_E2 until a later authorized preregistration.
Same-side paths must be reported and accepted separately; pooled directional performance cannot rescue a failed path.

required_machine_predicate_shape.text_is_not_execution: Natural-language descriptions may explain a predicate but cannot substitute for the typed fields or independent fixtures.

required_clean_checks: Exact cwd, branch, HEAD and immutable authority identities match this route.
Only the eight allowlisted artifacts are newly created and no existing artifact is modified.
Every artifact has an exact physical identity and every JSON contract or report has an independently recomputable domain-separated canonical identity.
The public validator is pure, total, fail-closed and pins authority, type, semantic and permission ceilings outside candidate content.
The exact clean bundle is accepted deterministically and repeated or reordered input cannot change its identity.
All active templates bind complete machine predicates and independent positive, boundary, clock, gap, hard-invalidation and expiry fixtures.
The graph is deterministic, finite, typed and preserves same-side distinct paths, opposing directions, OTHER_PATH, UNKNOWN_PATH and ABSTAIN semantics.
The evidence ledger is atomic, lineage-aware, idempotent, conflict-preserving and unable to convert ordinal or mechanism support into probability, utility or permission.
The independent reviewer reproduces every critical mutation without importing the builder's fixture constructor.
The evidence report and inventory state every unresolved blocker and make no market or later-stage claim.
mandatory_adversarial_families: Runtime template or LLM story injection.
Outcome-conditioned generation, graph backdating or prior-revision rewrite.
Same-side path merge, opposing-direction pruning or finite-pool overflow suppression.
Duplicate path identity used for repeated support.
Path identity contaminated by mechanism identity or trade side.
Trade hypothesis with zero or multiple parent paths.
Mechanism score transferred into path, trade, utility, size or permission.
Equal opposing evidence silently erased by tie-breaking.
Hard invalidation overridden by a score or expired instance revived.
OTHER_PATH, UNKNOWN_PATH, CENSORED and ABSTAIN interchanged.
Ordinal score, uncalibrated map or mechanism support represented as probability, expected value or numeric information gain.
Next observation available only after expiry or decision deadline.
Same-side out-of-sample results pooled to hide a failing parent path.
Unknown, abstained or censored opportunities removed from the declared denominator.
D0 through E3 or any market, adapter, evaluation, paper, deployment or trading permission enabled.
acceptance_contract.acceptance_effect: Acceptance would establish only the exact E0 P0.1 runtime-graph theory and contract candidate. It would not promote CORE v2.1, authorize D0 or validate any market behavior.

builder.scope: Implement only the eight exact allowlisted E0 artifacts and run local synthetic checks.

independent_reviewer.scope: Independently reproduce identities, validators and adversarial mutations without builder helpers.

stage_gate_reviewer.scope: Called only after a complete exact candidate or a genuine route blocker; issues ACCEPT_P0_1 or REWORK_LOCAL.

immediate_stop_conditions: A required change targets an existing or non-allowlisted artifact.
An authority identity, cwd, branch or HEAD differs from this decision.
Any data, adapter, dataset, backtest, calibration, holdout, paper, deployment or trading action becomes necessary.
A subjective mechanism explanation is required to satisfy a typed path, trade or evidence contract.
The finite path pool cannot preserve required direction and residual coverage.
A requested claim exceeds E0 contract validity.

open_findings.condition: Natural-language hard falsifier and expiry descriptions are not executable predicates.
open_findings.this_decision_effect: REMAINS_OPEN. This route authorization and any theory prose do not close the finding. Only exact machine predicates, independent fixtures and a later external Sol finding disposition could do so.

claim_boundary.maximum_positive_claim: This decision authorizes construction of exactly eight new E0 artifacts for a state-conditioned, three-layer runtime hypothesis-graph challenger and its pure synthetic validation package. It accepts no candidate, closes no empirical question, does not close F-005/DSP-022, does not change CORE_TRADING_THEORY.v2.1 and grants no D0 or later-stage permission.
